user.title: Mijia Camera setup
user.description: This integration reuses the login session and device list of the official 'Xiaomi Home' integration, so no Mi Home account/password is needed. Please install and log into the official Xiaomi Home integration first, and make sure your cameras are synced there.

credentials.title: Local RTSP credentials
credentials.description: In the Mi Home app, open the camera → Settings → enable 'LAN view'. The page shows the RTSP username/password (verification code); fill per camera.

error.no_xiaomi_home: No logged-in official Xiaomi Home integration found. Install and log in first.
error.no_cameras: No cameras found in the official Xiaomi Home integration.
